files_changed.summary: Removed nested Tls.PASSWORD, Tls.keytool, Tls.load and Tls.serverContext copies; Tls.init now calls TestCertificates.keytool/load/serverContext with the same arguments. Dropped now-unused imports (static Assert.fail, FileInputStream, KeyStore, KeyManagerFactory).

Added package-private static issued(File dir, String ca, String name, String dname, String san) holding the five keytool steps (genkeypair alias server RSA 2048 validity 3, certreq, gencert by ca with -ext san validity 3, importcert CA under alias ca, importcert server).
Private issued(ca, name, dname, san) now delegates to TestCertificates.issued(dir, ca, name, dname, san); all call sites unchanged.
Removed Tls.server; Tls.init calls TestCertificates.issued(d, "ca", "good"|"other", ...) with the same dnames and SANs (identical keytool arguments).
Replaced fully qualified java.io.IOException with the imported IOException at lines 132 (catch), 139 (throws), 218 (catch).

Renamed private field FullHandshakeSocketFactory.first to cipherSuiteSource (declaration, constructor assignment, getDefaultCipherSuites, getSupportedCipherSuites). The local CertificateException first in the trust check is untouched; no comment named the field.
